text:
Olivia (Marketing): Heads-up 16: we need to lock abstracts and speaker confirmations for the 'Inference at the Edge' webinar. Small checklist: speaker one-pagers, preview clips, fallback plan, and a pre-event survey.

Derek (Growth): I ran a lightning poll with a small community sample: top topic pick was 'latency optimization' followed by 'hybrid private-hosted routing'. Good signal.

Maya (Product): We'll frame around 'practical tradeoffs' with a live demo of routing policy fallback. Speakers: Maya (product), Tom (eng), and an external customer (TBD). Need customer availability.

Rafa (Design): I'll prepare a 3-slide teaser + a 10s animated intro. Also need speaker headshots for the event page.

Kaori (Ops): Can we reserve an extra 15m for speaker tech checks? Last time we lost 5m to mic trouble.

Jules (SDR): For lead follow-ups: I prefer tagging by poll response + demo attendance time. Will create a lead scoring column.

Olivia (Marketing): Proposed abstract below, open to edits.

Olivia (Marketing): "Inference at the Edge: How to keep latency low without blowing up costs. We'll walk through routing policies, batching, and an ops-friendly fallback that keeps your app online during spikes. Live demo + customer story."

Maya (Product): Love it. Suggest adding one line about observability hooks so folks know this isn't purely algorithmic.

Olivia (Marketing): Updated: includes observability note. Will finalize and send speaker one-pagers.

Derek (Growth): I'll run a small A/B on landing page copy: technical vs outcome-led. Will report early CTR data tomorrow.

Rafa (Design): Headshots pls by EOD. I'll make teaser variants once I have them.

Kaori (Ops): Backstage protocol: Zoom + local recording + streaming to Hopin. deploy-bot will post the recording link post-event.

deploy-bot: Recording will be posted to GDrive after processing.

Jules (SDR): Also requested: include the poll in the middle asking about current infra (cloud / on-prem / hybrid). Helps routing.

Olivia (Marketing): Nice. Polls: 1) infra type, 2) primary pain (latency/cost/data isolation), 3) readiness to evaluate. Keep it short.

Maya (Product): Demo fallback plan: if routing policy misbehaves in live run, swap to prerecorded sequence and call out exact logs/errors. We'll offer a post-webinar deep-dive session.

Olivia (Marketing): Owners: Abstracts + speaker one-pagers = Olivia; Teasers + assets = Rafa; Rehearsal scheduling = Kaori; Demo fallback + recording = Tom; Lead routing = Jules. Check-in Fri 4pm.

Derek (Growth): Running early ads test on copy A/B. Will share results tomorrow.

Olivia (Marketing): Thanks all. Please upload headshots and speaker bios by EOD. Closing thread.
